method: GET (no auth) of the JSON endpoint behind VoteWA's online voter guide; committed alongside this file with only the base64 "Photo" field of each record removed (every other field verbatim, re-serialized with indent=1)
statement_field: Each record's "Statement" field holds the candidate's statement (HTML) as entered for the general election; "CandidateStatementText" is empty and "IsApprovedForPost" is "False" on 2026-10-08, so the VoteWA page may not display it yet. Cite as the candidate's own submitted statement (Tier 1), not as the printed pamphlet.
